question: Can you help locate a takeout restaurant inside a 140 kilometers radius of West End Park, Queensbury, NY?
sql:
SELECT * FROM pois
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.679735 43.302111)',4326)::geography, 140000)
AND amenity = 'restaurant'
AND takeaway ILIKE '%yes%';

answers.description: Online ordering and app ordering available

answers.poi_name: Blossom Whole Food Kitchen and Catering
